access_note: The web research tool can retrieve the official query/count and event-detail pages. Direct sandbox Python HTTPS access failed with TLS/SSL connection closed, so a reproducible local bulk audit was not available in this session.
decision: Do not implement H3 yet. Product counts and one detail example establish source accessibility and mechanism-field existence, but do not establish the registered usable-count/spatial-coverage gate.
registered_viability_gate: At least 50 usable focal mechanisms distributed across at least 8 of 24 registered spatial blocks.
source: Official USGS ComCat FDSN Event Web Service
unverified: Count of unique events with finite usable nodal-plane strike and dip across the full query
Spatial distribution of those usable mechanisms across the registered 24 validation blocks
